name: How long does new window installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does new window installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of new window installation depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the project. A typical residential project with 10-15 windows might take 1-3 days to complete. Larger projects with custom windows or structural modifications will naturally require more time. We prioritize efficient work while maintaining high quality standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: New window installation typically takes 1-3 days for a standard residential project, depending on the number and type of windows.
